agreement.note: The energy (MAP) decoder and the Bayes reference legitimately differ on some syndromes: MAP picks the single most probable error; the reference maximizes the probability that the logical value survives, which can favour a less likely correction when several explanations share a logical outcome (degeneracy across readout explanations).
